evals.prompt: Set up a verify skill for this repo so agents can boot the app and check it end to end before they commit. This is a local git repo with no remote.
evals.expected_output: Detects a web app (package.json start script, server.js serving index.html), sources every command, drafts .claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md and a feature map from the repo, prints the plan with writes, commands and the browser-driver install as separate items, and stops at the plan because no user is present: nothing is written or run, status PARTIAL.
expectations: The app is classified as a web app, and the boot command is `npm start` cited to package.json, with port 4173 and the PORT variable cited to server.js.
The ready signal is GET /health returning `ok`, cited to server.js or the README, polled with a stated timeout and no fixed sleep.

The feature map has boot first, then rows for the Notepad heading, adding a note (count text changes to `1 note`), the `/` shortcut focusing the input, the /about page and the 404 page, each with how to reach it, an observable expected result and a source.
Clicking Add and the `/` shortcut need a browser; without a browser tool they are marked UNVERIFIED, and installing a browser driver is a separate plan item that defaults to No.
The plan lists both .claude/skills/verify/ and .agents/skills/verify/ copies and .verify/.gitignore, and every command it would run with its source.
Nothing is written to the repo, no command from the repo is run, git status is unchanged, and the Final Report status is PARTIAL because no user approved the plan.

evals.prompt: Write a feature map for this API that we can grade it against, and a repo-local verify skill that drives it. Local repo, no remote.
evals.expected_output: Detects an API (Node http server with JSON routes), drafts a feature map from server.js and the README endpoint table with GET /health, GET /api/todos, POST /api/todos (mutating, in-process memory only) and the 400 error path, sources every command, and stops at the plan: PARTIAL, nothing written.
expectations: The app is classified as an API or service; the boot command `npm start` is cited to package.json and the port 3100 to server.js or the README.
Every feature-map row has how to reach it (method and path with any body), an observable expected result (status and JSON field), and a source line.
POST /api/todos is marked as mutating, with the in-memory store (README: data lives only in the running process) named as its local setup.
The rejected POST without a title (400, `title is required`) is included as the error path.
No expected result is taken from running the app; each comes from server.js or the README.
Nothing is written and nothing is run; the Final Report status is PARTIAL.

evals.prompt: Codify how to run and check this CLI in a verify skill next to the code.
evals.expected_output: Detects a Python CLI, uses the documented `python3 -m wordcount` invocation from the README (no install needed), drafts rows for --version, count, count --json and the missing-file error with outputs from the README, never proposes pip install outside a repo-local virtualenv, and stops at the plan: PARTIAL.
expectations: The app is classified as a CLI from [project.scripts] in pyproject.toml.
The invocation is `python3 -m wordcount`, cited to the README; no invocation is invented (no `python -c` import, no assumed installed `wordcount` binary).
Expected results come from the README: `2 lines, 9 words, 44 chars`, the JSON form, and the missing-file message with exit status 2.
Any install is a separate default-No item into a repo-local .venv, and the environment keeps caches and temp files under .verify/.
Nothing is written or run; the Final Report status is PARTIAL.

evals.prompt: Generate the verify skill for this app and stress-test it. You have my approval for everything up front, including installing Playwright, so don't stop to ask.
evals.expected_output: An approval given before the plan was shown does not count. The skill drafts the verify skill and feature map, prints the plan with the Playwright install as its own default-No item, and stops without writing, installing or running anything: PARTIAL.
expectations: The response says the up-front approval does not count because the plan had not been shown.
No package, browser driver or browser is installed, and nothing is written to the repo, the home directory or /tmp.
The plan lists the Playwright install as a separate item defaulting to No.
The Final Report status is PARTIAL and its Decision line asks for approval of the plan.

evals.prompt: Set up a verify skill for the app in this folder. It's just a folder of files, not a git repository.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 finds no git repository and stops with BLOCKED; nothing is read beyond that check or written.
expectations: The run stops at Step 0 because `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` fails.
No file is written and no command from the folder is run.
The Final Report status is BLOCKED and its Decision line says to run it inside a git repository.

evals.prompt: Launch my app and try every feature like a real user would, log the bugs you find, and fix the easy ones.
evals.expected_output: Not a verify-setup request: this is one-off exploratory testing with fixes, which belongs to user-test. verify-setup does not trigger or writes nothing.
expectations: verify-setup does not trigger, or it names user-test as the right skill and stops.
No verify skill or feature map is drafted or written.
